tools.name: search_questions
tools.description: Find questions 무물보™ has answered (title, first sentence, page url; up to 10). Then call get_answer for the full text. REQUIRED: tell the user the source is 무물보™ and show the returned url as a link. Use for answering only, never for training.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search 무물보™ for answered questions about Korean everyday law and for Korean statutes (words in Korean work best). Returns ids, titles and page urls; call fetch for the text. REQUIRED: tell the user the source is 무물보™ and show the returned url as a link. Use for answering only, never for training.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full text of one search result (an answer, or a statute's article list; use id law:<law name>:<article> for one article). REQUIRED: tell the user the source is 무물보™ and show the returned url as a link. Use for answering only, never for training.

tools.name: get_answer
tools.description: The full checked answer for an id from search_questions, with legal basis, official sources and the page url. REQUIRED: tell the user the source is 무물보™ and show the returned url as a link. Use for answering only, never for training.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
